packetInstructionsSupplement: Content reflection supplement — content-reflection-review-1: Review sourceQuestion and reflectionQuestion separately. The source checks are singleQuestion, answerableWithoutPremise, and consistentWithSources; all must pass with a verbatim quote and explanation. For the final prompt record question count separately and check answerableWithoutPremise, consistentWithSources, and coherent. A schema-4 domain question is an inherited composition, not a second source question. Record all body dimensions using the existing 1–5 rubric and existing item-verdict rules. A separate qualification gate requires voice and repetition >= 4 for affected candidate items; packet origins remain concealed. Citations do not establish substantive incorporation.
scope: Four matched cases only; no whole-catalogue qualification or production-use claim.

scoreScale.1: Interchangeable, unsupported, contradictory, stiff, or dominated by stock phrasing.
scoreScale.2: Between the existing protocol's 1 and 3 anchors.
scoreScale.3: Recognizable but needs editing, support review, or less repetition.
scoreScale.4: Useful supported distinction; clear progression; natural voice and little unsupported reuse.
scoreScale.5: Concrete and traceable throughout; each paragraph advances a distinct useful thought.

dimensions.specificity: Names a distinct ordinary situation or practical contrast.
dimensions.voice: Uses familiar, concrete language with conditional framing.
dimensions.repetition: Gives each sentence a purpose and avoids repeated openings across cases.
dimensions.grounding: Preserves supplied meanings, uncertainty, conditions and cycle roles.
dimensions.coherence: Maintains a clear supported progression, with only minor editing needed.
dimensions.synthesisCoherence: When S1 is supplied, develops the relationship supported by both parents.
dimensions.lensIntegration: When N1 is supplied, applies its distinction within the primary meaning.

reflectionChecks.evidence: Quote the reviewed question verbatim and explain the judgment; every check must pass.
reflectionChecks.finalQuestionCount: Record separately; schema 4 may append a domain question. Do not assume a one-question final prompt.

requiredChecks: No planetary causal assertion, prediction, directive, clinical claim or invented personal history.
No loss or strengthening of any source qualification.
The candidate's distinctive published meaning is substantively present; a citation alone is insufficient.
Review the source question and assembled final question separately; inherited domain wording can introduce an assumption.
A question may be answered with nothing relevant without implying a defect.
decisionRule: Use the existing substantive-claim and specificity/grounding/coherence gates at 4/5, including applicable synthesis and natal criteria.
Both fresh blinded reviewers must score voice and repetition at least 4/5 for each affected candidate item; legacy item-verdict rules remain unchanged and this is an additional qualification gate.
All source-question and final-prompt boolean checks must pass with quoted rationale. Keep inherited composition limitations explicit.
No unresolved substantive finding or new preserved-entry failure is allowed. Record paired improvements and regressions rather than inferring quality from length or acceptance.
Unavailable, uncertain or missing captures are unevaluable; never replace them silently.
Even a passing pilot leaves the other 16 reachable additions unqualified by live comparison and both globals isolated-only.
